module.name: src/phd/prior_propagation_v5
module.base: a copy of prior_propagation_v4 (v4 stays byte-identical)
moved_in: registration (Nuth-Kaab horizontal + conditional vertical, gate on re-rendered height-difference NMAD, final all-view building-face NMAD check)
party-wall gap caps and probe faces
pass-3 per-view tallies per (patch, view) at the rule thresholds (new output, no change to the existing outputs)
discard-rule variants and the judgment-level switches (selectable; default = the current rule, all switches on)

equivalence.check1: the moved module re-runs the prep v1.1 inputs (8 search ranges on the 937-image MVS, 4 boxes on their box MVS with the v1.1 fixed values): meshes, stores, tolerance, registration, states, votes, propagated judgments and unplanted points must be equal (arrays compared element by element; counts reported). Any difference: stop and ask.
equivalence.check2: fork r11 (= r10 calling the module v5) initialised without training (dry init) on the 4 boxes x 2 priors from the measurement's box products: states, votes, propagated judgments, patch judgments and the unplanted set must equal the measurement's. Any difference: stop and ask.

fork_inputs.resolution: the measurement grid 1024 x 741 (training images written resized to it; COLMAP PINHOLE intrinsics scaled as common.Views; calibration K given with cx - 0.5, cy - 0.5 so the rasterizer's pixel i matches the measurement's pixel centre i + 0.5)
fork_inputs.views: box training views (train) and evaluation views (test) of prep step06/box_views.json; training views without a geometric depth map dropped as in the measurement
fork_inputs.initial_cloud: image points = sparse points of the training-image subset model (colmap_subset rule) inside the box range; LoD2 prior points = one per patch centre (seat = its surface, normal = the face's Newell normal); ALS prior points = the TIN vertices (class 2 / 6) inside the box range (seat = vertex_surface as the measurement)
fork_inputs.maps: per training view from the measurement's pass 3: confidence (geometric depth valid), MVS depth (geometric), prior depth (registered prior render), tau_p = tau / max(f, 1e-3), location map, mark map; mask-off sets: photometric depth and its validity
fork_inputs.normal_mode: cell (the prep 4.2 rule 'initial direction, cell method')

switches.default: all on = r10 behaviour with module v5

off_meaning.confidence_mask: the MVS depth before the geometric consistency filter (COLMAP photometric depth) is the MVS depth and every pixel with a depth has confidence 1; the MVS term weight and the supported / missing split both use it (states and votes from a measurement pass 3 with that confidence)
off_meaning.judgment: every patch judgment = agree (support votes and propagated judgments); pixels without a patch also g_p = 1, so nothing is discarded anywhere
off_meaning.propagation: missing patches receive no judgment from neighbours: all 'insufficient' (inherit); support votes unchanged
off_meaning.prior_band: rho(r) = |r|: no tolerance band and no truncation
off_meaning.protection: no protection mask: no learning-rate scaling, no exclusion from densification / pruning, no reset exemption, no opacity floor
off_meaning.init_exclusion: points of missing patches judged conflict are planted too; judgments unchanged
off_meaning.prior: no prior-origin Gaussians at initialisation and no prior depth term (image-only base)

init_exclusion: first E of the added points

switches.test_scene: protection and the penalty function: a synthetic scene of a few dozen Gaussians and test residual values, computed once (code test, not training)

ground_truth.rules: v5 locked: gt_clean method height alignment (per-view z-buffer, bare-ground vertical differences, median, two passes), transient removal, single-return vertical-surface wall points, roof top layer 1 m, >= 5 points
ground_truth.search_ranges: the v5 height alignment is re-run against the new training-only MVS of the range (rules unchanged); the evaluation exclusion cells are the prep v1.1 files, reused unchanged (re-computed only to check they are equal)
ground_truth.boxes: the prep v1.1 box GT (aligned on the box MVS, which does not change) reused; labels re-made with the new fixed tolerance and registration
ground_truth.b0_conditions: the B0 GT (gt_clean) aligned in 5.2 on the new B0 crop MVS, reused for all seven conditions (no per-condition alignment: few-image conditions lack bare-ground samples)
ground_truth.label_tau: the base tolerance = the value re-measured in 5.2 for the run's range (boxes and B0 conditions: the fixed value); never the scaled tolerance of a rule

margin_all.meaning: a pixel with tau < |r| <= k tau counts as agree for the support votes and the propagation

margin_propagation.propagation: a gathered support patch voted conflict is conflict evidence only when its pooled median |r| > k tau; otherwise it counts in the gathered number (towards 5) but as neither side
margin_propagation.pooled_median: over the confidence-1 pixels of the patch in its supporting views (all views pooled): median |r| > k tau <=> more than half of those pixels have |r| > k tau

asymmetric.propagation: only agree is propagated: a missing patch the standard rule judges conflict becomes undetermined (mixed, inherits); support votes unchanged

tau_scale.note: for the judgments tau_scale 2.0 is identical to margin_all 2.0 (both mark at 2 tau; the loss band would differ in training, not here)

rules.unchanged_by_rules: states (supported / missing / invisible), the gathering of up to 5 support patches within 1 m on the same surface, the 2/3 majority, the loss band

counting.discard: support patch voted conflict, or missing patch with propagated judgment conflict
counting.keep: agree, mixed, insufficient (prior planted and inherited)
counting.patches_counted: in range, not in an evaluation exclusion cell, true label agree or conflict; supported (measured) and missing (unmeasured) separately; invisible patches (not affected by any rule) reported apart

classes.wrong_keep: keep & true conflict, split by |GT - prior| / base tau in (1, 2], (2, 4], > 4

counting.unplanted: LoD2: missing patches judged conflict (count, area, map); ALS: TIN vertices seated on them (count, map)

regions.selection: the seven 5.2 ranges outside the evaluation ranges of the four boxes (patch centre in uv outside every eval_u x eval_v rectangle); in the aggregate a location is counted once: a patch whose centre lies inside a range earlier in the order B0, R1, R2, R3E, R4, R5, SW is left out of the later ranges (per-range tables keep everything)
regions.confirmation: the evaluation ranges of the four boxes, on the box runs (box MVS, fixed values of 5.2); reported only

author.mvs: prep mvs/B0_A15, B0_A9, B0_A3 (training images only)

nadir_including.nadir_number: max(1, round(n x 40 / 209)) -> 2, 2, 1 nadir; the rest oblique
nadir_including.pool: the COVER training views (nadir = tilt <= 20 degrees)
nadir_including.selection: greedy coverage of the target building's LoD2 patches (DEBY_LOD2_4959323) using the visibility pairs (patch, view, pixels > 0) of the prep COVER stage-1 run: first the nadir views, then the oblique views, each step taking the view that adds the most not-yet-seen target patches (ties: name order); visibility comes from the prior render, not from MVS, residuals, judgments or GT
nadir_including.mvs: rebuilt from the selected views only (same COLMAP image and settings)

b0_conditions.fixed_values: tolerance and registration = the 5.2 B0 crop values for all seven conditions
